items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the prose piece 'The Interview', and answer.

"The scientist kept a small notebook in her coat pocket. In the eight minutes of a taxi ride, in the queue at the bank, in the pause while her computer started, she jotted down an idea or solved one line of a problem. 'People think I work all night,' she laughed. 'I don't. I just never waste the little gaps.'"

What do people wrongly think about her?
items.answer: That she works all night.
items.markingKey: That she works all night. (1–2 marks for a complete answer.)
